item.title: Can High-Dose Vitamin D Prevent Long-COVID Cognitive Decline?
item.description: A massive new trial finds that Vitamin D may be the secret weapon against Long COVID’s "brain fog," even if it doesn't stop the initial infection.

item.title: Five High-Risk Neuron Groups Identified in ALS and FTD
item.description: New research reveals five specific types of neurons that are the primary targets of ALS and FTD, paving the way for cell-specific therapies.

item.title: Humans Are Born With a Biological Blueprint for Music
item.description: We are born to beat. New research confirms that musicality is a fundamental biological trait, not a cultural accident, predating language in human evolution.

item.title: Teens with ADHD Face Higher Risks of Anxiety and Depression
item.description: New research identifies the specific life factors that turn ADHD into anxiety and depression for millions of teenagers.

item.title: High-Fat Diets May Allow Gut Bacteria to Infiltrate the Brain
item.description: A new study reveals that a high-fat diet can turn the vagus nerve into a highway for gut bacteria to reach—and potentially inflame—the brain.

item.title: Major Risk Factor for Rare Early-Onset Dementia Found
item.description: Scientists discover a massive genetic risk factor for a rare form of FTD, proving that "personality-changing" dementia has a clear biological cause.

item.title: Overlooked Brainstem Pathway Discovered to Control Human Hands
item.description: New research reveals that an evolutionarily old pathway in the brainstem is a secret key to how humans use their hands.

item.title: Diverse Biological Roots of Alzheimer’s Revealed
item.description: Alzheimer's doesn't follow the same biological script for everyone, highlighting critical differences across racial and ethnic groups.

item.title: Lifelong Motion Patterns Predict Lifespan
item.description: A lifelong study of killifish reveals that aging happens in sudden bursts, and your mid-life "syllables" of movement might predict your future.

item.title: Immune Cells in the Brain Discovered to Control Puberty and Reproduction
item.description: Scientists discover that fertility is controlled by the brain's defense cells, identifying a new genetic link to human infertility.
